parsed.name: Red Pitaya STEMlab 多功能测试测量平台
parsed.name_en: Red Pitaya STEMlab multifunction test and measurement platform
parsed.description: Red Pitaya STEMlab 是一类可通过网络进行控制的多功能电子测试测量设备，通常集成信号发生、数据采集和基础示波测量能力，适用于实验室中的波形产生、信号观测、控制实验和自动化测试。
parsed.description_en: The Red Pitaya STEMlab is a network-controllable multifunction electronic test and measurement instrument, typically combining signal generation, data acquisition, and basic oscilloscope-style measurement capabilities for laboratory waveform generation, signal observation, control experiments, and automated testing.

actions.description: 自动建立与设备的 SCPI 通信并生成可用命令地址空间。
actions.description_en: Automatically establish SCPI communication with the device and build the available command address space.
